messages.content: Perform only the requested narrow decision. Return valid JSON only.

TOTAL BEATS: 8

FIXED CHAPTER 1:
Setup plus the main repeated process, explicitly described as the majority of the story.

FIXED CHAPTER 2:
Final resolution plus immediate closure.

Every chapter must receive at least one beat. Counts must sum to 8. The majority chapter must receive more than half.

Return JSON with key beat_counts, an array of two integers in chapter order.
